display.purpose: Brand wordmark and panel titles only.

ui.purpose: All functional text: buttons, rows, tables, labels.

mono.purpose: Tallied numeric values, primarily DKP totals.

shadows.name: panel-lip
shadows.purpose: Standard glass-panel edge highlight + soft cast shadow.

shadows.name: button-press
shadows.purpose: Offset shadow reading as a raised, pressable control.

shadows.name: modal-cast
shadows.purpose: Deep soft shadow for elements floating above the whole page (modals, auth card).

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Default hover/active transition for buttons, chips, item rows.

motion.name: sheen
motion.purpose: Slow animated gradient sweep across the primary button.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one high-emphasis action per view. Animated brass sheen, dark ink text, offset press shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 11px 22px; font: 600 13px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #231d17; border: 1px solid var(--accent-edge, #8a6428); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--accent-lo, #c08f45) 0%, var(--accent, #cf9a4e) 32%, var(--accent-lit, #f2d296) 46%, var(--accent, #cf9a4e) 60%, var(--accent-lo, #c08f45) 100%); background-size: 260% 100%; animation: ds-sheen 5s ease-in-out infinite; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--accent-under, #7d5a24), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3), 0 0 20px -6px rgba(207,154,78,.7); transition: filter .14s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-lit, #f2d296); outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-sheen { 0% { background-position: 130% 0; } 60%, 100% { background-position: -40% 0; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis actions: cancel, leave, admin utilities.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { padding: 11px 22px; font: 600 13px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a322b, #2c2620); color: var(--accent, #cf9a4e); border: 1px solid var(--border-mid, #5a4c40); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--surface-well, #171310), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(226,205,168,.08); cursor: pointer; transition: all .14s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--border-active, #7a6136); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-lit, #f2d296); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Section navigation pill; active state carries the same visual weight as a primary button.
components.css: .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 9px 16px; font: 600 12px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted, #ab9d8a); background: rgba(255,255,255,.03); border: 1px solid rgba(226,205,168,.12); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab--active { font-weight: 600; color: #2c2013; background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--accent-lit, #f2d296) 0%, var(--accent-hi, #e0ad5f) 55%, var(--accent, #cf9a4e) 100%); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Standard glass content container over the stone background.
components.html:
Item Detail

Panel content goes here.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 16px 18px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(226,205,168,.15); border-radius: 2px; backdrop-filter: blur(5px) saturate(1.2); background-image: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(255,250,238,0) 22%, rgba(255,250,238,.16) 42%, rgba(255,250,238,.02) 50%, rgba(255,250,238,0) 68%), radial-gradient(70% 50% at 12% -8%, rgba(255,250,238,.16), rgba(255,250,238,0) 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(226,205,168,.1) 0%, rgba(226,205,168,0) 30%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(48,40,33,.38), rgba(28,24,20,.38)); box-shadow: inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255,250,238,.42), 0 16px 34px -22px #000; color: var(--ink, #e3d8c4); transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-panel:hover { border-color: rgba(255,250,238,.42); } .ds-panel-title { font: 500 17px/1.2 Newsreader, serif; margin: 0 0 11px; color: var(--ink-bright, #f0e4cd); }

components.name: Search Input
components.css: .ds-search-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--surface-well, #171310); border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #453b33); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--ink-muted, #ab9d8a); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.45); } .ds-search-row__input { flex: 1; padding: 10px 0; background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--ink, #e3d8c4); font: 500 12.5px/1.3 Archivo, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-search-row:focus-within { border-color: var(--border-active, #7a6136); }

components.name: Item Row
components.description: Dense list row used across the item database, wishlist, and DKP roster.
components.css: .ds-item-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 9px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink, #e3d8c4); text-align: left; font: 500 12.5px/1.3 Archivo, sans-serif; transition: all .14s ease; width: 100%; } .ds-item-row:hover { background: var(--surface, #2b2521); }

narrative.overview:
GuildLog reads as a brass-bound account book kept open on a stone lectern in a guild keep, not a flat SaaS dashboard rendered in a browser. Every surface sits on a masonry stone texture; panels are cut from a single recurring "glass" recipe so the whole app reads as one pane of glass laid over old stone, not a stack of unrelated cards. The brass accent (Worn Brass) is reserved for the things a member is meant to act on: primary buttons, the active tab, DKP totals, live-status. It is deliberately not spread everywhere - its rarity is what makes it read as valuable rather than decorative.

The system is weighty and tactile, a little worn - pill-shaped buttons with a real offset drop-shadow that reads as pressed rather than flat, engraved rule-dividers, visible stone grain. It explicitly rejects two directions: the light, flat-card look of generic SaaS admin tools, and a cartoonish, saturated "mobile gacha game" fantasy skin.
keyCharacteristics: Dark stone-masonry ground with a brass/gold glass sheen over every panel
Brass accent used sparingly - reserved for primary action, active state, and value (DKP, live status)
Pill-shaped buttons and tabs; small, sharp radii (2-3px) on panels, cards, and form controls
Rarity-coded gem colors (rare blue, epic purple, heroic/brass gold) borrowed from the game itself
Serif display face (Newsreader) for headings and brand type; sans (Archivo) for everything functional; mono (JetBrains Mono) for numeric/DKP values

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Worn Brass is the only saturated hue against the ink/stone palette outside of status and rarity colors. If a new element wants a highlight color, it reaches for brass or it stays neutral - it does not introduce a second accent hue.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-Ceremony Rule
rules.body: Newsreader appears only on brand type and panel titles - never on body copy, buttons, or table cells.

rules.name: The Pressed-Not-Flat Rule
rules.body: Anything clickable gets a solid offset shadow that implies it can be pressed. Anything that only contains content gets the glass treatment instead.

dos: Do keep Worn Brass rare - primary action, active state, and tallied values only.
Do use pills for anything clickable and sharp 2-3px radii for anything that contains content.
Do give clickable controls an offset "pressed" shadow; give containers the glass treatment instead.
Do keep mobile layouts a rearrangement of the desktop reference state rather than a separately designed mobile skin.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated accent hue alongside Worn Brass.
Don't flatten panels into plain solid-color cards.
Don't drift toward a light flat-SaaS look or a cartoonish saturated fantasy-game skin.
Don't use a large "soft card" border-radius; the sharp small radius on containers is intentional.
